title: Micah 1: chapter overview
paragraphs: The wrath of God against Israel.
Also against Jerusalem and other cities, Their precautions vain.

outline.text: The wrath of God against Israel.
Also against Jerusalem and other cities, Their precautions vain.

context: Micah was raised up to support Isaiah, and to confirm his predictions, while he invited to repentance, both by threatened judgments and promised mercies.
attribution: Matthew Henry, Concise Commentary (public domain). Historical Protestant interpretation; other traditions may read these passages differently.
